   1 class_name DamageSystem extends System
   2 
   3 @export var runtime: Node = null
   4 var _contact_tick: int = -1
   5 var _contacts: Dictionary = {}
   6 
   7 func setup() -> void:
   8 	assert(is_instance_valid(runtime))
   9 
  10 func sub_systems() -> Array[Array]:
  11 	return [[q.with_all([C_Health, C_Transform, C_Body]).enabled(), _health], [q.with_all([C_Hitbox, C_Transform]).enabled(), _hitboxes], [q.with_all([C_Projectile, C_Transform, C_Body]).enabled(), _projectiles]]
  12 
  13 func _health(entities: Array[Entity], _components: Array, delta: float) -> void:
  14 	for entity in entities:
  15 		if not entity.enabled:
  16 			continue
  17 		var health: C_Health = entity.get_component(C_Health)
  18 		health.hurt_left = maxf(0.0, health.hurt_left - delta)
  19 		health.invulnerable_left = maxf(0.0, health.invulnerable_left - delta)
  20 		if health.heal_requested:
  21 			health.current = health.maximum
  22 			health.dead = false
  23 			health.hurt_left = 0.0
  24 			health.invulnerable_left = 0.0
  25 			health.heal_requested = false
  26 		if health.dead and health.hurt_left <= 0.0 and entity.id != runtime.session.player_id:
  27 			runtime.request_removal(entity.id)
  28 
  29 func _hitboxes(entities: Array[Entity], _components: Array, _delta: float) -> void:
  30 	if runtime.session.mode != "playing":
  31 		return
  32 	var targets: Array = runtime.world.query.with_all([C_Health, C_Transform, C_Body, C_RoomMember]).enabled().execute()
  33 	for entity in entities:
  34 		if not entity.enabled:
  35 			continue
  36 		var hitbox: C_Hitbox = entity.get_component(C_Hitbox)
  37 		if hitbox.active_left <= 0.0 or not _owner_can_hit(hitbox.owner_id):
  38 			continue
  39 		var position: Vector2 = entity.get_component(C_Transform).position
  40 		var rectangle := Rect2(position - hitbox.size * 0.5, hitbox.size)
  41 		for target in targets:
  42 			if not _eligible(entity, target, hitbox.owner_id, hitbox.team) or target.id in hitbox.hit_ids:
  43 				continue
  44 			if rectangle.intersects(_body_rect(target)) and _apply_hit(target, hitbox.damage):
  45 				hitbox.hit_ids.append(target.id)
  46 
  47 func _projectiles(entities: Array[Entity], _components: Array, _delta: float) -> void:
  48 	if runtime.session.mode != "playing":
  49 		return
  50 	if _contact_tick != runtime.tick_index:
  51 		_contact_tick = runtime.tick_index
  52 		_contacts = runtime.take_projectile_contacts()
  53 	var targets: Array = runtime.world.query.with_all([C_Health, C_Transform, C_Body, C_RoomMember]).enabled().execute()
  54 	for entity in entities:
  55 		if not entity.enabled:
  56 			continue
  57 		var projectile: C_Projectile = entity.get_component(C_Projectile)
  58 		var body: C_Body = entity.get_component(C_Body)
  59 		var motion: C_Motion = entity.get_component(C_Motion)
  60 		if projectile.consumed or not body.ready or motion.placement_pending:
  61 			continue
  62 		var end: Vector2 = entity.get_component(C_Transform).position
  63 		var nearest: Entity = null
  64 		var nearest_t: float = INF
  65 		for target in targets:
  66 			if not _eligible(entity, target, projectile.owner_id, projectile.team):
  67 				continue
  68 			var rect: Rect2 = _body_rect(target).grow_individual(body.size.x * 0.5 + 0.15, body.size.y * 0.5 + 0.15, body.size.x * 0.5 + 0.15, body.size.y * 0.5 + 0.15)
  69 			var fraction: float = _sweep_fraction(projectile.previous_position, end, rect)
  70 			if fraction >= 0.0 and fraction < nearest_t:
  71 				nearest = target
  72 				nearest_t = fraction
  73 		if nearest == null and _contacts.has(entity.id):
  74 			var contacted: Entity = runtime.world.entity_id_registry.get(_contacts[entity.id])
  75 			if is_instance_valid(contacted) and contacted.get_component(C_Health) != null and _eligible(entity, contacted, projectile.owner_id, projectile.team):
  76 				nearest = contacted
  77 		if nearest != null:
  78 			_apply_hit(nearest, projectile.damage)
  79 			projectile.consumed = true
  80 		elif _contacts.has(entity.id):
  81 			projectile.consumed = true
  82 		if projectile.consumed:
  83 			runtime.request_spawn("effect", entity.get_component(C_RoomMember).room_id, {"position": end, "kind": "impact", "duration": 0.18, "color": Color(0.7, 0.8, 1.0), "size": Vector2(28, 28)})
  84 			runtime.request_removal(entity.id)
  85 
  86 func _eligible(source: Entity, target: Entity, owner_id: String, team: String) -> bool:
  87 	if not target.enabled or target.id == owner_id:
  88 		return false
  89 	var health: C_Health = target.get_component(C_Health)
  90 	var body: C_Body = target.get_component(C_Body)
  91 	return not health.dead and health.team != team and body.ready and source.get_component(C_RoomMember).room_id == target.get_component(C_RoomMember).room_id
  92 
  93 func _owner_can_hit(owner_id: String) -> bool:
  94 	var owner: Entity = runtime.world.entity_id_registry.get(owner_id)
  95 	if not is_instance_valid(owner) or not owner.enabled:
  96 		return false
  97 	var health: C_Health = owner.get_component(C_Health)
  98 	return health == null or (not health.dead and (health.hurt_left <= 0.0 or owner.get_component(C_Boss) != null))
  99 
 100 func _body_rect(entity: Entity) -> Rect2:
 101 	var body: C_Body = entity.get_component(C_Body)
 102 	return Rect2(entity.get_component(C_Transform).position + body.offset - body.size * 0.5, body.size)
 103 
 104 func _apply_hit(target: Entity, amount: int) -> bool:
 105 	var health: C_Health = target.get_component(C_Health)
 106 	var combat: C_Combat = target.get_component(C_Combat)
 107 	if health.dead or health.invulnerable_left > 0.0 or (combat != null and combat.dodge_invulnerable):
 108 		return false
 109 	health.current = maxi(0, health.current - maxi(amount, 0))
 110 	health.hurt_left = 0.28
 111 	health.invulnerable_left = 0.45 if health.team == "player" else 0.16
 112 	health.dead = health.current <= 0
 113 	var body: C_Body = target.get_component(C_Body)
 114 	runtime.request_spawn("effect", target.get_component(C_RoomMember).room_id, {"position": target.get_component(C_Transform).position + body.offset, "kind": "defeat" if health.dead else "impact", "duration": 0.38 if health.dead else 0.2, "size": Vector2(86, 86) if health.dead else Vector2(36, 36), "color": Color(1, 0.73, 0.4) if health.dead else Color(1, 0.85, 0.8)})
 115 	return true
 116 
 117 func _sweep_fraction(start: Vector2, end: Vector2, rectangle: Rect2) -> float:
 118 	var low: float = 0.0
 119 	var high: float = 1.0
 120 	var displacement: Vector2 = end - start
 121 	for axis in 2:
 122 		if absf(displacement[axis]) < 0.00001:
 123 			if start[axis] < rectangle.position[axis] or start[axis] > rectangle.end[axis]:
 124 				return -1.0
 125 		else:
 126 			var a: float = (rectangle.position[axis] - start[axis]) / displacement[axis]
 127 			var b: float = (rectangle.end[axis] - start[axis]) / displacement[axis]
 128 			low = maxf(low, minf(a, b))
 129 			high = minf(high, maxf(a, b))
 130 			if low > high:
 131 				return -1.0
 132 	return low
